Sara —

Thanks, and great questions. Short answers up front, followed by a slightly more detailed operational summary attached.

- Cross-region processing: By default, hosted requests are routed to the nearest region. If you enable "region affinity" (EU pinned) active inference—request handling and KV/prefix caches—will remain in the EU. However, non-real-time activities (telemetry aggregation, model telemetry for quality monitoring, and scheduled retraining/feature-extract pipelines) may run in our analytics cluster in the US unless you opt into our EU-only analytics path. Those transient analytics jobs do not store raw prompts; they operate over pseudonymized aggregates and embeddings.

- Keys: Customer data encryption keys for EU-hosted workloads can be customer-managed in an EU KMS; we do not escrow customer CMKs to a US provider unless explicitly requested. For customers on shared KMS routing, automated key-rotation backups for control-plane audit purposes are retained in our control-plane region (currently US) for 30 days but can be disabled under the EU DPA addendum.

- Subprocessors: Attached is the current roster (subprocessor-roster-2028-10.csv). Last updated 2028-10-05. No planned onboarding in the next 90 days aside from the routine CDN edge provider update noted in the file.

I’ve attached a one-page "residency-ops-summary.pdf" that maps where each processing category runs (inference, KV cache, telemetry, retrain, backups) and the default retention windows. Karthik — can you confirm the opt-out steps for the analytics path and an estimated lead time for turning on EU-only analytics for a new tenant? Marissa, will loop you into the legal addendum thread for precise DPA language.

Cheers,
Avery Johnson

> - Cross-region processing: By default, hosted requests are routed to the nearest region. If you enable "region affinity" (EU pinned) active inference—request handling and KV/prefix caches—will remain in the EU. However, non-real-time activities (telemetry aggregation, model telemetry for quality monitoring, and scheduled retraining/feature-extract pipelines) may run in our analytics cluster in the US unless you opt into our "EU-only analytics path." 

Sara / team — quick ops clarification: the above is accurate but a few specifics to set expectations operationally:

1) Analytics jobs: The analytics pipeline consumes pseudonymized event records (tokens are hashed and truncated) and operates on aggregated windows. For a standard hosted tenant with "EU affinity" but no addendum, we keep a 72-hour transient buffer in our US analytics cluster to handle cross-region aggregation spikes and replay scenarios. This buffer is not searchable by prompt text and is deleted automatically. If MediHealth requires zero transient buffer outside EU, we can enable EU-only analytics; lead time ~ 10 business days (we schedule a data-plane migration and reconfigure batching endpoints).

2) Retraining & model telemetry: Scheduled retrain tasks may pull aggregated feature vectors to a training cluster (US). We can redirect retrain to EU-only infrastructure for customers on an enterprise DPA addendum. This requires an ops ticket and a small monthly surcharge to cover reserved capacity.

3) Failover & DR: In the event of region-wide outage we have an emergency failover path that can process EU traffic in the nearest healthy region (typically UK or FR edge -> US core). There is a documented failover SLA and a required customer approval to enable cross-region failover in the DPA. We can limit automatic failover and require manual escalation.

4) Keys: For EU CMKs: if you choose customer-managed keys (CMK) in an EU KMS, we do not export them. Control-plane audit trails that require short-term backup are stored in our control-plane region only if you accept the default template; Marissa can add language in the addendum to remove that copy.

Operational ask: If MediHealth wants EU-only analytics and retrain routing by default, confirm in writing and we’ll start a provisioning ticket. Estimated schedule: 10 business days for analytics-only, 20 business days if retrain pipelines also need EU routing (reservation of compute + legal addendum signed).

—Karthik
